topic: Gyroscopic precession rate — units/value mismatch, post-hoc, no dome derivation
change_summary: Decider self-apply (ISS-3044, fixed 2026-08-09T02:14Z) replaced the trailing sentence of detail_verdict_text that had re-imported the value-match assumption. Verification re-review (class=verification) that the patch closed the c6 hole0 seam cleanly.
our_argument_summary: WIN-021 argues the dome claimed gyroscopic precession rate (4.87e-12 rad/s^2) is Misleading on three independent grounds: (1) units error — rad/s^2 is angular acceleration, but precession is an angular velocity (~7.73e-12 rad/s, the 25,772-yr cycle) (data/wins.json:021 detail_evidence); (2) even correcting rad/s^2->rad/s charitably, 4.87e-12 falls 37% below Earth measured 7.73e-12 rad/s; (3) no derivation connects dome geometry to the number (derives_from_dome=false) and it is post-hoc (post_hoc=true). monitor.py has no domain for this WIN (monitoring=none, data/wins.json:021 code_analysis).

code_analysis_tags.monitoring_evidence: grep of raw-text/monitor.py for precess/gyro/4.87 returns zero hits; the value lives only in raw-text/02-wins.txt:106 as a WIN-list string. No fetch, no comparison. -> none.
code_analysis_tags.relabels_standard_evidence: Standard physics fully explains axial precession via luni-solar torques on the equatorial bulge (50.2881 arcsec/yr, IAU 2006). The dome offers NO alternative mechanism to relabel (detail_evidence: The dome provides no alternative mechanism that predicts this specific rate from first principles). No mechanism substituted -> relabels_standard=false. Borderline but defensible: post_hoc=true carries the phenomenon-predates-the-dome point.
code_analysis_tags.post_hoc_evidence: Axial precession and its ~50 arcsec/yr rate are millennia-old textbook physics; the dome adopts the phenomenon and labels it confirmed. detail_verdict_text explicitly makes the post-hoc argument and correctly concedes the dome number does not even reproduce the textbook value.
code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome_evidence: No derivation path from dome geometry to 4.87e-12 is offered; the value neither matches the standard 7.73e-12 rad/s nor is traceable to disc_radius/firmament_height. Circular-fit acknowledged in detail_evidence.

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome is right that Earth exhibits gyroscopic axial precession — a real, large phenomenon (the ~25,772-yr cycle, 50.2881 arcsec/yr per IAU 2006, cited via data/wins.json:021 detail_evidence). Naming gyroscopic precession at all shows the model author knows the phenomenon exists and is torque-driven.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Knowing precession exists is not predicting its rate. The dome quoted 4.87e-12 rad/s^2 (raw-text/02-wins.txt:106) is dimensionally wrong (acceleration, not velocity) and, corrected to rad/s, is 37% below the measured 7.73e-12 rad/s (data/wins.json:021 detail_evidence). With derives_from_dome=false and monitoring=none, there is no sense in which the dome predicted the value — the WIN adopts a textbook phenomenon it cannot reproduce.

deeper_analysis: VERIFICATION PASS (class=verification, ISS-3044). The c6 hole0 (moderate) flagged the trailing sentence of detail_verdict_text as re-importing the value-match assumption the c5 fix removed, since WIN-021 is the one non-matching outlier. ISS-3044 (fixed 2026-08-09T02:14Z) replaced that sentence with exactly the c6 recommendation. Verified by grep of the fresh clone: WIN-021 detail_verdict_text no longer contains algebraically equivalent or value is not obscure, and now contains the recommended millennia-old textbook phenomenon ... it neither matches the standard value nor is derived from dome parameters wording. The c6 seam is CLOSED for WIN-021. Independently re-verified all quantitative claims: 25,772-yr cycle -> 7.725e-12 rad/s (matches ~7.73e-12); (7.73-4.87)/7.73 = 37.0%; 50.2881 arcsec/yr -> 7.725e-12 rad/s (self-consistent); IAU 2006 P03 secular acceleration = 2x the t^2 coefficient (~1.105 arcsec/cy^2) ~ 2.21 arcsec/cy^2 -> ~9.7e-25 rad/s^2 ~ 1e-24, ~12 orders below the dome number; angular-acceleration runaway over 1 yr = 4.87e-12 * 3.156e7 = 1.54e-4 rad/s ~ 2e7x Earth actual rate. All hold. Citation DOI 10.1051/0004-6361:20031539 (Capitaine, Wallace & Chapront 2003, A&A 412 — the P03 precession model) is the correct source. No new holes on WIN-021.
